No live replay; original Graph success checked event existence/start; per-inbox delivery and later editor identity remain unverified. Direct legacy fixture contexts carry the declared unframed literal as currentUserMessage. Orchestrated turns receive an explicit empty typedUserMessage if no typed source is available. Core, actual connector and resolver boundaries have distinct executed fixtures. Matching pre-fix original and rejected a1 are retained; external human delivery and later editor identity remain outside these checks. Bouncer original partial-edit fixture before/after: artifacts/workshop-verification/incident-20261111/matchmaker/a3/independent-before.tap and artifacts/workshop-verification/incident-20261111/matchmaker/a3/independent-after.tap, the original product fail switches from a POST to internal Alex to a POST to approved external Alex. Fresh source-bound typed-source regression artifacts/workshop-verification/incident-20261111/matchmaker/a3/framing.tap (19/19). Earlier before/after records retain their attempt labels; the final package runs current tests on the exact snapshot. This is fixture POST serialization, not inbox receipt.
